identity.head: 03b18d4720304fb84e2271c0e4a2e99b4bd607a4
identity.description:
Turn dismissed findings into goldens through the pool, and resume a pool run (D4b R3)

D4b revision R3: findings that the verifier dismissed become goldens through the pool.

## What changes

- `pr-review pool --dismissed`: a finding that the verifier dismissed (`dont_post` or `not_real` in `stages.verifications`) counts when its record saw the head of the case. The pool already adjudicates it, so no new adjudication path and no new model call exist.
  - Both families keep it (75 or more): it stays a pool golden, and the note names the verifier's label. The labeler gives the label.
  - Both families score it below 50: the outcome is `dismissed_golden`. It becomes a golden with the placeholder `unsure`, and the labeler labels it, normally `not_real`. It does not join a kept item.
  - Any other result: no golden. The summary names each case.
  - The verifier's label goes to `pool-key.json` only. No adjudication request holds it.
- `pr-review pool --resume`: each call that succeeds goes to `<out>/<case>/calls.json`. A second run with `--resume` makes only the calls that are missing or failed. Why: a pool run today lost $12.74 of Claude calls when Codex reached its usage limit.
- README, design doc and a TICKETS.md progress line.
- No scoring change. The eval already counts a posted finding that matches a `dont_post` golden as a false positive (`test/eval-score.test.ts`, "counts a judge match to a %s golden as a not-real match").

## The goldens follow in the cases repo

The records hold 19 dismissed findings, all in PRs 41, 44, 45 and 46 of this repo. No record holds a finding that a person dismissed. Seven are at the first recorded head. The four cases `pool-pr-review-41`, `-44`, `-45` and `-46` are made. Their goldens follow on cases repo branch `r3-dismissed-findings` after Codex returns. This PR does not wait for them.

No pin move and no baseline: the final D4b baseline PR does both for all four revisions. The version is not bumped, so that the sibling revisions do not conflict on it.

## Tests

`test/pool-dismissed.test.ts` and `test/pool-resume.test.ts` run the CLI with a fake SDK client and a fake `codex`. `npm test` (1396), lint, typecheck and build pass.

triage.summary: Adds two features to `pr-review pool`. `--dismissed` turns verifier-dismissed findings into goldens, marking them in pool-key.json and adding a `dismissed_golden` outcome when both families score below 50. `--resume` keeps successful model calls in calls.json and reuses them when the inputs match. Docs and tests are included.
